# Evidence contract — Platform Governance

Governance documentation repository (docs, contracts, org state) — no web
UI and no runtime to exercise. Honest evidence instead:

- The governance artifacts ARE the product: `docs/`, `GOVERNANCE.md`,
  `latest-org-state.json`, cross-repo contracts — all real, committed,
  rendered on GitHub.

`product-main.webp` (a technical product visual rendered from repository
architecture, **not** a UI screenshot) was removed — no UI surface exists.

Generated or edited mock UI must never be presented as evidence of
implemented behavior.
